evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Deliberate contrast within one frame: owned vs. rented intelligence set as matched opposition.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Substrate-as-commodity and perspective-as-asset are metaphoric mappings; the semicolon sets them as antithesis — commodity vs. asset you keep.
